display.title: Episode 400: The Diamond from Heaven (Shabbos Bereishis)
display.summary_short: After the Tishrei holidays, Uncle Yossi explains how to carry their awe and joy into the year, then tells how Rashi's father gave up a priceless diamond to sanctify Hashem's name.
display.summary_long: Broadcast the week of Shabbos Bereishis 5750, just after the Tishrei holidays. Uncle Yossi explains what to take from the Yomim Tovim: Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur give us yiras Shamayim, the careful concern to do each mitzvah exactly as Hashem wants (a mezuzah with even one faulty letter is not kosher, which is why we learn the Shulchan Aruch), and Sukkos and Simchas Torah give us simcha shel mitzvah. The Alter Rebbe reads 'asher kideshanu' in every brachah as 'how fortunate we are'. After the Hakochainik march, three sisters visiting from California for Sukkos recite the Shema and share the thrill of receiving a dollar from the Rebbe. Story time, framed as a father telling his son Shmuel, who is starting Chumash: Rabbi Yitzchak, a Torah scholar and diamond dealer in France, buys a rare diamond, then learns the governor wants it for an idol. Rather than help beautify idol worship, he lets the stone fall into the sea, and a heavenly voice promises him a son who will light up the world with Torah: Rashi. The show ends with Shabbos candle-lighting times.
display.lesson: Carry the awe and joy of the Yomim Tovim into the whole year, and be ready to give up even great wealth to bring honor to Hashem's name.
